title: Positions in order (prayer mat outlines)
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y1 lesson 14 (Pupil PDF worksheet: positions in order (prayer mat outlines))
intro: Lesson 14: The positions of salah. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: We face the qiblah
points: All Muslims face the Ka'bah in Makkah
This way is called the qiblah

head: Position
What we do
rows: Forehead, nose, hands, knees, toes on the floor
Sit between and at the end

blocks.text: Draw a prayer mat in each box and write the position: stand, bow, sujud, sit. Put them in order. (No people.)

keywords.def: the way we face to pray, towards the Ka'bah
putting our forehead on the floor

questions.q: Show me ruku' and say its name.
questions.a: Bow with hands on knees: ruku'

questions.q: On the pupil PDF, put the four position pictures (prayer mat outlines, no people) in order: stand, bow, sujud, sit.
Extend: say 'Allahu akbar' and tell me when we say it.
questions.a: When we move to a new position

questions.q: Stretch: why do Muslims all face one way?
questions.a: We all face the Ka'bah; it shows we are one ummah.

questions.q: Which position puts our forehead on the floor?
questions.a: A) Sujud. Sujud: the closest we are to Allah. Ruku' is bowing; qiyam is standing.

questions.q: Think again: what would you say to Allah in salah?
questions.a: For example: thank You, Allah, for my family.
